rules.text: Mission Buddy notices a resource below the safe planning level.
rules.answer: Protect the resource that is lowest first, then check what your choice costs. Keeping all three resources steady helps the crew.

rules.text: Mission Buddy gives a general resource-check reminder when no resource is low.
rules.answer: Check power, oxygen, and shielding together before you choose. Keeping them balanced gives the crew more options.

rules.text: Mission Buddy checks the active event and its severity before suggesting a plan.
rules.answer: Look at the event type and severity, then protect the resource that counters it. Check the delayed costs before you choose.

rules.text: Mission Buddy gives a general event-check reminder when no event is active.
rules.answer: No event is active right now. Keep checking the resources and look for delayed costs before your next choice.

rules.text: Mission Buddy connects the engineer perspective with the current power-check scene.
rules.answer: Start with power: make sure the choice leaves enough energy for life support and the next step. Then check oxygen and shielding too.

rules.text: Mission Buddy gives a general role-check reminder outside the engineer power scene.
rules.answer: Use your role's goal to guide the choice, then check power, oxygen, and shielding together.

rules.text: Mission Buddy uses the reviewed OSDR metadata snapshot and states its evidence limit.
rules.answer: The reviewed NASA snapshot contains 424 study records. These are metadata topic labels, not measurements or health findings.

rules.text: Mission Buddy checks immediate and delayed costs before a choice.
rules.answer: Check what the choice gives you, what it spends, and whether a delayed cost appears later. A careful astronaut checks all three resources.

rules.text: Mission Buddy uses the game rules to encourage a balanced plan.
rules.answer: A careful plan watches power, oxygen, and shielding together. Small safe choices can help the crew reach the next scene.
